title: Vela incident labeled the '747 incident'

tellings.quote:
>> It's it's called uh the seven they
labeled it as the 747 incident.

plain: In 1979 a Vela satellite, one of the US satellites built to spot nuclear tests, recorded a flash over the South Atlantic that has been linked to South Africa or Israel, and according to a former CIA officer named Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, insiders labeled it "the 747 incident". He says he heard this from an unnamed scientist at the US Department of Energy. The label suggests the event was handled under a cover name inside government.
